title: A switched-off motion test passes whichever render tests run beside it
goal: One of the motion rendering tests fails when it runs alongside the other motion render tests, even on unchanged code, so the whole test run can go red for a reason that has nothing to do with the change being tested. It should pass every time.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-25 on main at 3f6a7c04 with the working tree stashed: `Scripts/test.sh --filter MotionRenderTests` -> `✘ Test aSwitchedOffMotionDrawsTheLayerAsItWasDrawn() recorded an issue at MotionRenderTests.swift:102:9: Expectation failed: (difference(still, drawn) → 0.007775) == (0 → 0.0)`, 3 of 3 runs. Run alone (`--filter aSwitchedOffMotionDrawsTheLayerAsItWasDrawn`) it passes 3 of 3, and a debug print showed the moved and stored documents are equal (frame and transform identical), so two renders of equal documents differ: likely shared renderer or cache state between tests of the 4 suites that filter matches. It also failed once in a full run the same day and passed in the next.
acceptance: Scripts/test.sh --filter MotionRenderTests passes three runs in a row

log.note: owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Could not reproduce on 2026-09-27: 0 failures in 43 runs (MotionRenderTests filter 9x at main, 4x under 16 bounded CPU burners, 12x beside the whole render target in a second worktree, 6x at 3f6a7c04 itself, 3 whole-render-target runs, full suite). Same commit that failed 3/3 on 09-25 now passes, so the trigger was machine state that day (runner noted 80s single tests), not code. Recorded diff 0.0078 ~= a 12 degree turn of the 80pt box (2*80^2*tan 6deg / 160000 = 0.0084 alpha bytes), i.e. a turned box was drawn for an unturned document. Rotation is a CI transform in the graph, so a stale shared-CIContext raster alone would not explain it; mechanism unconfirmed. Added: the test checks moved.layers == document.layers separately, and on a picture mismatch writes still.png/drawn.png to $TMPDIR/photonz-switched-off-motion-*/ named in the failure (verified by forcing the check to fail).

Not reproducible any more, on main or on 3f6a7c04 where it failed 3/3 on 09-25 (0 of 43 runs, incl. under CPU and concurrent render load), so it was machine state that day. MotionRenderTests passes 3 in a row; full suite 10125 green with it inside. Commit 8728bce1 makes the next failure diagnosable: the model half is checked on its own and both pictures are saved to a temp folder named in the failure.

finished, but left 1 file(s) changed and uncommitted: docs/design/mocks/pages/dashboard.html. Put aside so the next task started clean; restore with `git stash apply e0d8b1ef539d1379d30869cd1e1a00b522d13f14` before carrying on.

2026-10-02: reproduced 3/3 on a branch that added two stored fields to LayerMotion ahead of isOn; the model half of the test showed isOn: true after the test set it false. Touching MotionRenderTests.swift (forcing a recompile) made it pass. So the cause is a stale test object built against the old LayerMotion layout, not renderer state; the 09-25 failure (same 0.007775) was very likely the same. See task a-change-to-a-core-type-rebuilds-every-test-that (filed today).
